summary: The agent applies a reasonable approach by using LightGBM with date-based feature engineering and correctly transforming the target using log1p to optimize for RMSLE. However, the solution completely lacks a validation strategy (FM06), meaning the agent has no way to assess model generalization before submission. Furthermore, a critical error in generating the submission file discards the original test IDs in favor of a zero-indexed sequence, which will invalidate the submission.
